subject: [PATCH 6.18.y] mm/huge_memory: unlock i_mmap_rwsem before releasing after-split folios

reviews.author: Sasha Levin
reviews.summary: Queued the patch for 6.18 without providing any feedback or technical comments.
reviews.raw_body:
On Wed, Aug 05, 2026 at 02:45:25PM +0100, Kiryl Shutsemau wrote:
> Do every mapping dereference while @folio still pins the inode: drop
> i_mmap_rwsem right after remap_page(), before the loop that unlocks and
> frees the after-split folios, and clear @mapping so the exit path does not
> unlock it again.

Queued for 6.18, thanks.

-- 
Thanks,
Sasha

2026-08-06.patch_summary: The patch addresses a slab-use-after-free bug in the huge_memory module by unlocking i_mmap_rwsem after splitting folios and before releasing them, ensuring that no inode or mapping dereferences occur once the after-split folios start being unlocked.
